name: Feature grid
definition: Grid of six short benefit blocks, each with an icon, a bold title and one supporting sentence.
bestUse: Summarising what the product does after the hero, before deeper sections.

demo.how: Six parallel blocks let a visitor scan what the product does in seconds; each title is a benefit and the sentence says how. Play shows the section title, then the six blocks. Keep titles to a few words and the sentences to one line. Features are illustrative.
